pages.name: Pirc Defense: Austrian Attack, Weiss Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the queen Qe1-h4 with the king still on e1 and pushed g4-g5 as one move. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Pirc: Austrian, 5...c5 6.Bb5+
pages.notes: Plan 4 pushed ...b5 onto the bishop's square while Black is in check; plan 3 called the check a pin. Rewrote plans 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Pirc: Austrian, 5...c5 6.Bb5+
pages.notes: Plan 2 wrote an '...a6-b5' route into the b5-bishop's square. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Pirc: Austrian, 5...c5 6.Bb5+ Bd7 7.e5 Ng4 8.e6 Bxb5
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Kg8 before the f7-pawn falls; plan 1 assumed 9.exf7+ Kxf7, but the king usually goes to d7. Rewrote plans 1 and 2 (reviewer: first draft of plan 2 put the king on g8, rejected, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Breyer Variation, Stein Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Ba3 pressing a d6-pawn Black doesn't have, through White's own b4-pawn. Rewrote plan 1 (reviewer: first draft said Bb2 supports b4, rejected, revised to a3, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Endgame Offer
pages.notes: Plan 1 named Kxd1 after Black's moves in an ambiguous order; plan 3 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Hillbilly Attack, Schaeffer Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed a knight Nc3-f3 with no knight on c3. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Scorpion-Horus Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured Bxd3 before ...exd3; plan 4 pushed ...g5 onto the bishop's square. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Breyer, 3.Nd2 e5
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted the d2-knight via f1 with the f1-bishop still at home; plan 1 wrote castling as 0-0 and called the e-file open. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Breyer, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed e4-e5 into Black's e5-pawn. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.
